$comment: Copy this file to src/config/personal.json and edit it. personal.json is gitignored, so your real content never leaves your machine. Every field here is optional — anything you omit falls back to these generic defaults.
$comment_petNames: Cute nicknames. A different one greets them on every open, and none repeats until the whole list has been used — so the longer this list, the longer before you hear one twice. Put the real ones here, in your gitignored personal.json.
compliments: You are doing better than you think you are.
The world is softer because you are in it.
Someone thought of you today and smiled.
You are allowed to take up space.
Your kindness is not a small thing.
You don't have to earn rest.
You are more than the hardest day you've had.
The way you notice small things is a gift.
You've survived every single thing so far. That counts.
Being you is enough. It always was.
gratitudePrompts: What's one small thing that went right?
What did your body do for you today?
What's something you're looking forward to, even slightly?
What's a sound you liked today?
What's one thing you'd tell your past self about right now?

memories.caption: A placeholder memory. Drop your own photo in public/memories/ and point at it here.
Captions can be as long or as short as you like.
If image is null, Bloom draws a soft gradient card instead.
Add as many as you want — the wall just keeps scrolling.
The small days are the ones worth keeping.
memories.date: No idea, but it was nice
